title: Minimum time heading
description: Essential: The student must state the boat heads perpendicular to the riverbank (or directly across).

title: Minimum time calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the crossing time using t = d / v2, yielding 36 s.

title: Minimum distance heading
description: Important: The student must determine the boat heads upstream at an angle θ such that sin θ = v1/v2 (or θ = 30°).

title: Resultant velocity for minimum time
description: Important: The student must correctly find the resultant speed (e.g., sqrt(v1² + v2²)) to compute the displacement.

title: Minimum distance displacement
description: Essential: The student must state the displacement equals the river width (180 m) when crossing directly across.

title: Minimum distance time
description: Important: The student must correctly compute the crossing time using t' = d / (v2 cos θ), yielding approximately 41.6 s.

title: Vector component reasoning
description: Optional: The student clearly resolves velocities into perpendicular and parallel components for both parts.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly assigns the heading direction (e.g., downstream for minimum distance) or misplaces the angle.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: The student provides numerical answers without correct units (s, m) or uses inconsistent units.
